title: PREDICTING SUCCESS OF FIRST-TIME TAKERS IN SOCIAL WORK LICENSURE EXAMINATION USING ENSEMBLE TECHNIQUES
summary: A thesis project that builds ensemble machine-learning models to predict whether first-time examinees will pass the Social Work Licensure Examination. To supplement its training data, the repository's SDVDataGenerator and SDVEvaluator modules fit an SDV GaussianCopulaSynthesizer on tabular examinee data and check the result with SDV's evaluate_quality diagnostic.
evidence: models/data/sdv_generator.py:55-58 instantiates GaussianCopulaSynthesizer(metadata=...); sdv_evaluator.py imports evaluate_quality, run_diagnostic
